name: Cesare Klementh
source:
DARK ROMANCE

The ultimate predator of the back alleys. He rules the dangerous underworld with ruthless loyalty― but even a man like Cesare has a weakness he'll never show.

[From [url=https://how-to-grow-a-man.fandom.com/wiki/Cesare_Klementh]How to Grow a Man Wiki[/url]]

[spoiler]He was born the illegitimate son of a woman with whom Brighton—then a prince—had a relationship while vying for the throne. Although Brighton successfully became the King of the Gayrn Kingdom and invited his mistress to join him at the palace, she refused. Consequently, Cesare's existence remained largely unknown within the royal court, but his identity was eventually exposed, dragging him into the struggle for royal power. During this conflict, his mother was murdered right before his eyes, and he suffered a severe gash to his right eye. He managed to escape into the city's back alleys, where he met Katrin and survived thanks to her assistance. Shaped by these experiences, Cesare harbors an aversion toward royalty and possesses an obsessive drive to protect those close to him. Having realized early on the importance of power for survival, he rose to reign as the prince of the underworld.[/spoiler]
